preconditions.display_state: Automatically blanked before the tests: bl_power=4, panel power retained by the existing driver. Stayed off throughout.
preconditions.screen_daemon: Paused all tabs3-screen.service processes with SIGSTOP and resumed the same processes with SIGCONT in a cleanup trap, preserving their existing off state. Did not restart the daemon because its startup forces the screen on.
preconditions.frame_submissions: Held tty1 in KD_GRAPHICS with the existing measurement helper. Waited three seconds, then required zero kickoffs before every packet. Restored original console mode on exit.
preconditions.fixup: Existing boot fixup had completed long before the measurements; no fixup replay or reset.

R1.question: Does the proposed vendor read method retrieve known calibration instead of the previous response?
R1.offset_write: HS 15 b0 <offset> before each vendor read
R1.conclusion: Known D8 calibration reads work in both HS and LP in this static, display-off-but-powered state. They return the requested offset value independently of the preceding ID response.
R1.limits: Does not establish that the same requests work during active frame transfers or cold initialization.

R2.method: For each offset, seed once with ID DA=42 and once with ID DB=40, then issue HS 15 b0 <offset> followed by HS 24 d2 01 1.
R2.conclusion: D2 returns distinct, stable values at the four queried offsets, independent of the ID seed. ELVSS 1b, ACL 12 and averaging 05 agree with the intended normal settings.
R2.limits: This snapshot is after the current boot fixup and an automatic display-off. It is not a pre-fixup or freshly failed recovery snapshot, and does not prove that the output stage latched or visibly used those values.

R3.method: With frames stopped and the display already off, write B2[36]=10 plus update key, then read D2[36] after two different ID seeds. Write B2[36]=12 plus update key, then repeat the two ID-seeded reads.
R3.cleanup: Sent the ACL-on sequence again from the EXIT trap; all four transfers succeeded.
R3.conclusion: D2[36] tracks controlled writes to B2[36] in this state. It is live readback of this tested setting, not an unchanging factory default.
limits: One off/on cycle with two independent ID-seeded reads per phase.
Does not prove every B2 offset has the same read semantics or that B1 has a corresponding readable bank.
No pixel data was sent and no optical output was observed. A live register value is not proof of correct panel emission or a repaired wake path.

script_abort_gates: Abort on any unexpected frame kickoff before a command.
Abort if R1 calibration or identity controls do not return the expected byte; do not attempt R2/R3.
measurement_controls.cleanup: ACL-on writes on R3 exit, console mode restored by helper, tracing disabled and instance removed, paused service resumed by outer trap.

next_measurements: Use the now-validated D2 path for B2 drive-setting snapshots at defined lifecycle stages, with no frames during reads.
For E2, capture before the timer fixup using a controlled diagnostic boot; record reset, TCON-ready, display-on and first-frame ordering separately.
For E3, compare the same D2 offsets before and after the compression re-latch, then separately assess the picture and current. A correct visible baseline is still needed.
Keep E1 dimming, colour validation and wake observation pending until the user is home.
interpretation_cautions: Passing static LP reads does not prove that streaming is the only reason previous LP reads failed; that would need a controlled comparison.
Absence of B1/B2 reads in Samsung source alone does not prove they are universally write-only; the earlier direct B1/B2 method is empirically unreliable here.
These measurements validate instrumentation and one live readback relationship. They do not identify the display failure root cause or validate patches 0026/0027.

final_state.ACL_15_percent_setting: 12, verified before repeated successful cleanup writes
